fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects commandline operations on shell history files
fields.name: Suspicious History File Operations
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="osx" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains ".bash_history" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ".zsh_history" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ".zhistory" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ".history" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ".sh_history" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "fish_history"))
